svg.text: Alex Morgan
Portland, OR | alex.morgan@example.com
Professional Profile
Analytics professional with experience in software, retail reporting, business intelligence, database reporting and
statistical analysis. Background includes managing analysts, developing reporting solutions, presenting findings to
management, working with product teams and supporting business planning. Interested in applying this
combination of technical and management experience to a senior analytics position with broader responsibility for
the business.
Qualifications & Technical Skills
Analytics leadership; roadmap prioritization; revenue measurement; customer segmentation; SQL; Python; Power
BI; experiment design; data validation; metric governance; executive presentations.; Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI,
Tableau, data analysis, statistics, database reporting, dashboard development, data visualization, business
intelligence, project management, stakeholder management, presentation skills, leadership, Microsoft Office.
Professional Experience
Director of Analytics | Cedar Metrics Inc. | 2020–present
Responsible for the analytics function and an eight-person team providing reporting and analysis for eight
regions. Manage requests from finance, sales, customer success and product, meet with department heads to
discuss priorities, assign work, review SQL and dashboards, and present weekly updates. Rebuilt the weekly
revenue reporting process, which previously took six hours to prepare and now takes approximately 45 minutes.
Work with product managers on checkout performance, including reviewing funnel data, agreeing on test
requirements, checking experiment setup and preparing results for discussion. The winning checkout test
increased completed purchases by 8% compared with the control. Also prepare customer segmentation reports,
investigate changes in conversion and answer follow-up questions from business partners about how the figures
were calculated.
Maintain reporting definitions and work with engineering on data issues. Introduced validation checks covering
12 source tables and documented common revenue and customer metrics for executive reporting. Participate in
planning meetings, maintain the analytics backlog, review dashboard access, prepare documentation and
support analysts with technical development and presentations. Facilitate quarterly roadmap reviews and
distinguish recurring reporting needs from one-off requests.
Senior Data Analyst | Harbor Retail Co. | 2014–2020
Developed and maintained sales reports for 20 stores, including weekly performance comparisons, monthly
trend summaries and requests from regional managers. Standardized the reporting templates and coached three
analysts on SQL reviews and communicating results. Worked with merchandising and finance on reconciliations,
investigated discrepancies between store and central reports, and maintained instructions for refreshing the
workbooks. Prepared seasonal planning analyses and presented findings at regional business reviews.
Reporting Analyst | Pine Systems Inc. | 2008–2014
Created SQL queries and recurring reports for finance and customer-support teams, reconciled operational data,
maintained spreadsheets and investigated missing or duplicated records. Responded to requests for extracts,
documented report logic and supported month-end reporting. Worked with colleagues to clarify reporting
requirements and explain differences between data sources. Provided walkthroughs of recurring reports to new
staff and maintained the reporting schedule.
Education
M.S. Analytics | Cascadia State University | 2014
B.S. Statistics | Cascadia State University | 2008
